units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39b:7">Ab. Zar. 39ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לא שבק ה׳ ואכל וכ׳</he> one will not let stand what is permitted and eat what is forbidden.
<cite ref="Chullin 111b:9">Ḥull. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ בלע</he> it absorbed permitted substances.
<cite ref="Chullin 111b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ דאתי לידי איסורא</he> a permitted substance which is bound to become forbidden (when coming in contact with milk).
<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:20">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כח דה׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00451"><he>כֹּחָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
